title: The General (silent film)
tone_mechanism: The expressionless face against catastrophe: the body reacts with full engagement while the face holds zero affect, and the surrounding situation supplies all absurdity. This is deadpan's origin case — the flat surface is visual/performative, not verbal, and is recorded here specifically to anchor the transfer limit: prose cannot reproduce the face and must substitute register-stasis plus withheld reaction (claim 7).
